info.name: client_secret
info.description: Application Client Secret (the secret Value, not the Secret ID)

info.name: from_address
info.description: Default sender mailbox (e.g. noreply@contoso.com). Can be overridden per task with the From (Override) input.

info.name: api_server
info.description: Kinetic Platform server URL, e.g. https://server/kinetic or https://my-space.kinops.io. ${space} is replaced with the space slug.

info.name: api_username
info.description: Kinetic user with access to the notification forms and related submissions

info.name: space_slug
info.description: Default space slug (used when the Space Slug input is blank)

info.name: kapp_slug
info.description: Kapp slug where the notification forms are located

info.name: form_slug_data
info.description: Form slug of the notification templates and snippets form

info.name: form_slug_dates
info.description: Form slug of the notification date formats form

info.name: max_attachment_size_mb
info.description: Maximum total size, in MB, of attachments and inline images in one email
